title: Katt Katt Kad Kaddu
overview: Katt Katt Kad Kaddu (2000) follows Saurabh, a young boy left in the care of his strict, retired naval officer uncle while his parents work abroad. Feeling isolated by his uncle's stiff communication style, Saurabh discovers a Morse code book. He learns the code and reaches out to a neighbor, finding friendship and connection through coded messages.
